subject: 客栈
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Keep this exact inn's visual style, architecture, warm timber, grey tiles, ivory plaster, guest balconies, courtyard, left-upper lighting, transparent background and all details. Correct ONLY the rectangular floor width/depth and camera projection. This is a 12 wide x 9 deep rectangle. Current front edge is too short relative to side; LENGTHEN the lower-left-facing frontage by 13 percent, leaving side depth fixed. The long floor edge from LEFT ground corner to FRONT ground corner must have horizontal run 4:3 relative to FRONT to RIGHT. Both ground edge angles must be exactly 26.565 degrees to horizontal, slopes +0.500 and -0.500, slightly flatter than the current image. Rebuild the actual walls, roof and courtyard to follow this geometry, not just transparent canvas padding. Consistent orthographic camera with straight parallel edges. Thin floor boundary all four sides, clean complete uncut sprite, generous empty margin. No text, people, modern objects, grid or labels. True transparent RGBA, no halo.
negative: 文字、标牌字、水印、人物、天空、地平线、背景色、棋盘格、厚地台、大阴影、现代物、清代形制、透视消失点、裁切屋檐、卡通。

references.role: image_gen candidate: geometry/style reference or edit target; not author approved

created_time_basis: 生成后记录的接收/归档时间；非工具披露的服务端调用时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面边；±3px不确定性；非3D测绘，隐藏后角未直接测得。

notes: 返修第2轮：已逐张view_image；底面宽深恢复，宋式灰瓦木构及商用/客栈陈设完整，无文字人物现代物，左上主光；底面接触角按可见地坪外缘读点并用alpha>=192轮廓复核。64×32网格叠图另存review2；细小轴向残差按geometry_qa如实登记，目视判断不等于严格几何通过。
